***Protect your work**. Save early and often. RStudio auto-save is not perfect!*


## Returning to a project

When returning to a project, make sure:

* The current working directory is correct
* Necessary packages are loaded
* The most recent version of the code was saved

These are small things to check for, but do so can help avoid unexpected result and lost time.
